name: Virginia Textile Service, Inc.
old_description: Since 1934, Your Linen Service has provided local linen, mat, and uniform rental services designed to help your employees thrive—so your business succeeds. From seamless laundry solutions to tailored programs, we support the hospitality, healthcare, and restaurant industries.
about:
Virginia Textile Service, Inc., operating as Your Linen Service, has been based in Petersburg, Virginia since its founding in 1934. The company remains family-owned and operated after more than nine decades.

The company provides textile rental and laundry services, supplying linens, uniforms, mats, and hygiene products to businesses across the Mid-Atlantic. Its model relies on a network of local service centers rather than large centralized plants, allowing for responsive delivery and pickup. Services include linen rental for hospitality and healthcare, uniform programs, mat and mop rental, and restroom hygiene dispensers and consumables.

Customers span restaurants, hotels, inns, country clubs, spas, healthcare clinics, hospitals, nursing homes, barber and beauty shops, and other commercial and industrial establishments. Testimonials reference accounts in Charlotte, Parkersburg, Norfolk, Maryland, Charlottesville, and Springfield, indicating a multi-state service footprint.

The company emphasizes its local structure, environmental stewardship, and personal customer service as differentiators. It describes its approach as "green" through resource conservation and notes that limiting service center size enables greater responsiveness than national competitors.
